P01.description: Uniform microstrip (settings 5.5, 15.3). FR-4 substrate 40 x 40 x 1.6 mm, zero-thickness PEC trace w = 3.07 mm along y over the full length L, full PEC ground under the substrate, air 20 mm above and airSide laterally, ABC on the outer boundary, lumped ports (R = 50 Ohm) joining the trace ends to the ground. Lengths in mm. conductor_surfaces: faces that become surface-impedance boundaries with conductorModel = "sibc" (value: conductor surfaces per face, 2 for the zero-thickness trace).

P01-1.description: 1 GHz, tanDelta = 0.002, stage 1 (zero-thickness PEC), medium mesh. Reference case, L/lambda_g ~ 0.24

P01-2.description: 10 GHz, otherwise as P01-1 (multi-wavelength propagation, L/lambda_g ~ 2.4)

P01-3.description: 0.1 GHz, otherwise as P01-1 (low-frequency regime, L/lambda_g ~ 0.024; same mesh as P01-1)

P02.description: Thin-substrate microstrip (settings 5.6). P01 layout (FR-4 substrate 40 x 40 x h, zero-thickness PEC trace of width w along y over the full length, full PEC ground, air 20 mm above and airSide laterally, ABC, lumped ports R = 50 Ohm) with h = 0.8, 0.2, 0.05 mm (h = 1.6 mm is P01). P02-a keeps w = 3.07 mm, P02-b keeps w/h = 1.92 (about 50 Ohm). The substrate is extruded in nH layers (flat tetrahedra, in-plane size w/nW near the trace), the air is Delaunay. Same labels, ports and parameter names as P01. Lengths in mm.

P03.description: Multilayer signal via (settings 5.7, 15.3). 4-layer FR-4 board 20 x 20 mm: L1 signal / 0.2 mm / L2 GND / 0.6 mm / L3 signal / 0.6 mm / L4 GND. L1 microstrip (w = 0.38 mm) from x = -10 mm to the via, L3 stripline (w = 0.55 mm) from the via to x = +10 mm. Signal via d = 0.3 mm, land 0.6 mm, antipad 0.9 mm; return vias between L2 and L4 at 1.0 mm diagonally. Air 5 mm around, ABC. Lengths in mm.

P03-2.description: 10 GHz, back-drilled via (no stub, ends at L3), 4 return vias

P03-3.description: 10 GHz, through via, no return via (excites the plane-pair resonances)

P03-a1.2.description: P03-1 with antipad diameter 1.2 mm (task L series: antipad diameter)

P04.description: Multilayer board with permittivity jumps (settings 5.8). Board 40 x 40 mm, four layers of 0.4 mm, from the bottom eps1, eps2, eps1, eps2 (eps1 = 1: Substrate, epsSub/tanDelta; eps2: Substrate2, epsSub2/tanDelta2 = 0.002), zero-thickness PEC trace w = 1 mm along y on the top, full PEC ground, air 20 mm above and airSide laterally, ABC, lumped ports (R = 50 Ohm) through the four layers at the trace ends. The board is extruded layer by layer (nH element layers per material layer), the air is Delaunay. Lengths in mm.

P06.description: Microstrip over a slot in the reference plane (settings 5.10). FR-4 board 60 x 60 x 0.8 mm (eps_r = 4.4, tanDelta = 0.02), zero-thickness PEC trace w = 1.54 mm along y over the full length, PEC ground at z = 0 as an internal surface (air 20 mm above and below, airSide laterally, ABC) with a slot of width slotW = 1 mm and length slotL along x under the middle of the trace. stitchD > 0: PEC bridges of width stitchW across the slot at x = -stitchD, +stitchD (part of PEC_Ground). Lumped ports (R = 50 Ohm) at the trace ends. All meshes use the 10 GHz size rule (meshFreqGHz); frequency sweeps with run --freq. Lengths in mm.

P07.description: Differential via pair, 4 ports (settings 5.11). The 4-layer board of P03 (20 x 20 mm, L1 signal / 0.2 mm / L2 GND / 0.6 mm / L3 signal / 0.6 mm / L4 GND) with two signal vias (d = 0.3 mm, land 0.6 mm, antipad 0.8 mm each) at pitch 1.0 mm: line P at y = +pitch/2, line N at y = -pitch/2; L1 microstrips (w = 0.38 mm) from x = -10 mm to the vias, L3 striplines (w = 0.55 mm) from the vias to x = +10 mm; 2 return vias (L2-L4) outside the pair. viaShift moves the N via along x (asymmetry). Ports 1, 2: L1 ends of P, N; ports 3, 4: L3 ends of P, N (single-ended, 50 Ohm). Air 5 mm around, ABC. Lengths in mm.
